اختطوا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَطَوْا (iḵtaṭaw) /ix.ta.tˤaw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِخْتَطَى (iḵtaṭā)
# اُخْتُطُوا (uḵtuṭū) /ux.tu.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِخْتَطَى (iḵtaṭā)
# اِخْتَطُوا (iḵtaṭū) /ix.ta.tˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِخْتَطَى (iḵtaṭā)
